name: qtwebengine
description: Qt WebEngine embeds Chromium to render web content in Qt applications.

pre: command -v bison flex gperf ninja >/dev/null || { echo 'qtwebengine: bison, flex, gperf, and ninja must be installed (LFS ch5/ch6)' >&2; exit 1; }
user:
(cd build && $QT6DIR/bin/qt-configure-module .. -- \
      -D CMAKE_MESSAGE_LOG_LEVEL=STATUS               \
      -D QT_FEATURE_webengine_system_ffmpeg=ON        \
      -D QT_FEATURE_webengine_system_icu=ON           \
      -D QT_FEATURE_webengine_proprietary_codecs=ON   \
      -D QT_FEATURE_webengine_webrtc_pipewire=ON      \
      -D QT_BUILD_EXAMPLES_BY_DEFAULT=OFF             \
      -D QT_GENERATE_SBOM=OFF                         \
      -D QT_SHOW_EXTRA_IDE_SOURCES=OFF                \
      -D QT_NO_FEATURE_AUTO_RESET=ON                  \
      && cmake .. && touch build.ninja)

grep -Eq '^(QT_FEATURE_qtwebengine_build:(BOOL|INTERNAL)=ON|QT_CONFIGURE_CHECK_qtwebengine_build:BOOL=ON)$' build/CMakeCache.txt || { echo 'qtwebengine: configure disabled WebEngine (qtwebengine_build=OFF); check cmake output above for missing tools/libs' >&2; grep -E '^QT_FEATURE_qtwebengine|^QT_CONFIGURE_CHECK_' build/CMakeCache.txt 2>/dev/null | sort; exit 1; }
package: test -f $DESTDIR/opt/qt6/lib/cmake/Qt6WebEngineWidgets/Qt6WebEngineWidgetsConfig.cmake || { echo "qtwebengine: Qt6WebEngineWidgets cmake package not staged" >&2; find $DESTDIR/opt/qt6 -name '*WebEngine*' 2>/dev/null | head -20; exit 1; }
